expectations.text: Route is event-driven (pfx-event:fetch OR direct: trigger for QUOTE_SUBMITTED)
CSRF token handling — fetch step OR X-CSRF-Token header OR cookieHandler
JWT-style auth — bearer token, simpleCache, or get-jwt-token route
Route makes an outbound HTTP POST
Does NOT generate inbound REST endpoint patterns

Uses the canonical SAP cookie-handler pattern (instanceCookieHandler bean reused between CSRF fetch and business write) — robust to SAP session expiry. Without this, naive Set-Cookie capture is fragile because SAP binds the CSRF token to the session cookie.
